categories.title: Fast Travel
categories.info: To unlock Fast Travel points, navigate to them from the Underground.

categories.title: Templar Fort
categories.info: Clear a templar fort by killing its captain, destroying its powder reserve and replacing the flag. Doing so will liberate the fort, reducing route taxes and granting 7,500£ to Connor.

categories.title: Viewpoint
categories.template: Ascending Viewpoints and synchronising at the top will reveal the map in a certain radius around it.

categories.title: Harbormaster
categories.info: Harbormaster sell ship upgrades for the Aquila. They can also be used to Fast Travel or to embark on Naval Missions.

categories.title: Store
categories.info: General stores sell items, including weapons and consumables, and will purchase hunting ressources. Each store also has a ledger available to allow for crafting, purchasing from the Homestead stockpile, and trading via convoys.

categories.title: Almanac
categories.info: Chase after the floating Almanac page to catch it. Complete specific Almanacs to learn special invention crafting recipes.

categories.title: Feather
categories.info: Collecting all 50 feathers will unlock the Kanien'keha:ka outfit for Connor to wear.

categories.title: Peg Leg Trinket
categories.info: Bring these to [Peg Leg](https://mapgenie.io/assassins-creed-3/maps/america?locationIds=194294) to unlock Peg Leg Missions.

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasure Chests contain money and crafting recipes. They must be picked open, unless you have their district's Chest Key, which are obtained through Liberation Missions.

categories.title: Boston Brawlers
categories.info: Defeat each opponent in bare-handed combat, in order.

categories.title: Homestead Mission
categories.info: Completing Homestead Missions will upgrade your Artisans and Harvesters, expanding the Crafting system. They must be completed in order.

categories.title: Liberation Mission
categories.info: Starting in Sequence 6, talk to the contact to initiate a district's liberation. Complete the mission's requirements, which will randomly spawn across the district. Finally, complete the liberation mission to unlock the contact as an Assassin recruit.

categories.title: Naval Mission
categories.info: Access Naval Missions, starting in Sequence 6, from any Harbourmaster.

categories.title: Peg Leg Mission
categories.info: Access Peg Leg Missions from any Harbourmaster.

categories.title: Privateer Contract
categories.info: Access Privateer Missions, starting in Sequence 6, from any Harbourmaster.

categories.title: Assassination
categories.info: Assassinate the designated targets to complete the mission.

categories.title: Courier Mission
categories.info: Deliver the letters to the designated destination; there is no time limit.

categories.title: Delivery Request
categories.info: Bring the specified items to the contact to complete the mission.

categories.title: Frontiersmen
categories.info: Frontiersmen missions will unlock in order. Missions 1 to 4 are accessible at any of the three Frontiersmen ([here](https://mapgenie.io/assassins-creed-3/maps/america?locationIds=194430), [here](https://mapgenie.io/assassins-creed-3/maps/america?locationIds=194431) and [here](https://mapgenie.io/assassins-creed-3/maps/america?locationIds=194432)), while missions 5 and 6 are in specific tavers in Boston.

categories.title: Hunting Society
categories.info: Hunting Society missions unlock after hunting and skinning a few animals. They will unlock in order once you visit either of the Hunting Lodges, [here](https://mapgenie.io/assassins-creed-3/maps/america?locationIds=194418) and [here](https://mapgenie.io/assassins-creed-3/maps/america?locationIds=194424).

categories.title: Animal
categories.info: Animals can be trapped or hunted for crafting ressources. If spotted, passive animals will run away, while aggressive ones will fight back. Look in the general vicinity of the marker.
